name: number-format
title: Number formatting
summary: A live counter of the seconds since midnight, formatted by textFromFloat with 0, 1 and 2 decimals.
prompt: Show a live number (seconds since midnight) formatted with 0, 1 and 2 decimal places.
teaches: Turn a live float into text with a textFromFloat value: whole digits, decimal places and flags
Compute seconds since midnight once, as a named resources.variables expression (timeInMin() * 60 + timeInSec() % 60), and reference it as @secs
Keep trailing zeros with flags 3 (PAD_AFTER_ZERO) and drop leading padding with 4 (PAD_PRE_NONE): flags 7

snippets.note: secs = timeInMin()*60 + timeInSec()%60, shared by the three lines
the same value with decimal 2: flags 7 keeps the .00

check.describe: At 10:10:05 the three lines read 36605, 36605.0 and 36605.00. Resized (240, 540 wide) the 80 dp label column stays put and the numbers keep their full width; at 240 36605.00 still fits.

pitfalls: timeInSec() is the second within the HOUR (minute*60 + second), not since midnight: at 10:10:05 it is 605
textFromFloat's default flags (0, PAD_AFTER_SPACE) print trailing zeros as spaces: 36605 with decimal 2 shows "36605.0" plus a blank; add PAD_AFTER_ZERO (3) to print 36605.00
`whole` is the number of integer digits KEPT, not a minimum: 36605 with whole 3 prints 605. Size it for the largest value (86399 needs 5)
Inside a text value object, decimal defaults to 3 when omitted; write decimal 0 for an integer
